arguments.body: Hi Luca, this is written notice that a Gas Safe engineer from HeatRight Ltd will visit 19 Victoria Park Road on Wednesday 14 October, between 9am and 12pm, for the annual gas safety check. The current certificate runs out on 16 October, so we need to do it this week. If that time doesn't suit, just reply or call us with another time before 16 October and we'll rearrange. We can't enter without your agreement. You'll get a copy of the record within 28 days of the check. If you ever smell gas, leave the property and call 0800 111 999.
